migration_mechanism.revision_policy: Immutable versioned revisions with one reviewed head per release candidate
migration_mechanism.deployment_lock: PostgreSQL advisory lock scoped to the database and migration program
migration_mechanism.transaction_policy: Transactional DDL where supported; online index and long-running data phases carry explicit transaction boundaries
migration_mechanism.review_artifact: Offline rendered SQL plus revision metadata and checksums
migration_mechanism.drift_gate: The expected head and database catalog projection agree before application traffic begins
migration_mechanism.remediation_policy: Applied revisions retain their bytes; corrective behavior arrives through a successor forward revision and an exercised recovery route

phases.name: baseline_and_lineage
actions: record predecessor baseline and catalog digest

phases.name: expand
actions: add compatible types tables columns constraints and indexes
introduce dual-write or projection adapters where required
add constraints through staged validation when table volume warrants it

phases.name: backfill_and_reconcile
actions: load bounded batches with durable compound checkpoints

phases.name: converge_and_shadow
actions: compare canonical reads events and query plans
exercise restore rollback and data exit

phases.name: contract_and_release
actions: move readers and writers to the canonical boundary
retire compatibility paths through a successor migration

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: source and canonical identity uniqueness and mapping coverage
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Every in-scope identity maps once or carries an accepted exception.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: schema field type nullability vocabulary and version coverage
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Every required field satisfies the released data contract or carries an accepted exception.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: scientific state quantity unit qualifier method and intended meaning
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Accountable scientific reviewers accept defined equality and tolerance rules.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: lineage custody assay approval signature artifact and trace edges
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Required edges preserve endpoint identity cardinality and version.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: counts null rates status distributions numeric summaries and exception rates
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Observed metrics remain within approved thresholds and every breach carries disposition.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: artifact inventory bytes digest media type and lineage
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Every in-scope artifact verifies its content digest or carries an accepted exception.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: actors times reasons authorization decisions events and supersession
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Representative histories reconstruct the approved business narrative.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: tenant scope row policies role grants redaction and retention
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: Adversarial tests demonstrate the released tenant and privilege boundary.

reconciliation_dimensions.measure: risk-based record review by scientific laboratory Quality and business roles
reconciliation_dimensions.acceptance: The approved sample completes with recorded decisions and owned exceptions.

verification_matrix: Empty database reaches the expected migration head.
Every supported predecessor reaches the expected head with preserved data.
Repeated execution preserves one migration history.
Interrupted data phases resume from durable checkpoints.
Concurrent identical and conflicting requests exercise idempotency and optimistic concurrency.
Cross-tenant reads and writes exercise row policies and privileged-role posture.
Direct event and evidence mutation exercises database privilege boundaries.
Equivalent instants decimals unit mappings JSON edge cases and status invariants exercise primitive contracts.
Representative query plans exercise indexes retention and partition decisions.
Backup restore rollback and data exit reconstruct the accepted evidence boundary.

metadata.next_review_trigger: The engine major, migration framework, source snapshot mechanism, reconciliation threshold, or release topology changes.
